test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

He is given proper guidance by his boss.

options.text: His boss has been giving him proper guidance.
He gives proper guidance to his boss.
His boss gives him proper guidance.
His boss is giving him proper guidance.

solution:
The correct answer is **'His boss gives him proper guidance'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. As per the question we have to change it into Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) 
 
 

 
• *Example:*

 
 
• *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) *
 
• *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'He'. 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'his boss'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'is given' will be changed into 'gives'.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *His boss gives him proper guidance.*
